evidence: Modifies txindex logic (src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h) to allow concurrent operation with block pruning.
rationale: Allows running -txindex concurrently with block pruning, addressing multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). As noted by contributors, having txindex retain all transaction metadata on pruned nodes significantly expands pruned node capabilities for transaction lookups and proof generation without requiring a full unpruned chain.
